chunks: And Muḥammad ibn Abī Ḥamzah narrated from Abū al-Ḥasan al-Awwal عليه السلام that he said:
"If seepage appears behind the latrine and it is in the direction of the qiblah, he should cover it with something."
ai.seo_question: What should be done if seepage appears behind a latrine in the direction of the qiblah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal instruction related to maintaining proper etiquette toward the qiblah in the area of a latrine. It directs that visible seepage located toward the qiblah should be concealed with something.
